set(ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_INCLUDE_DIR ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_ROOT}/include)
set(ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_IMPLIB ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_ROOT}/lib/ElaWidgetTools.lib)
set(ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_RUNTIME ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_ROOT}/bin/ElaWidgetTools.dll)

if(NOT EXISTS ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_INCLUDE_DIR}/ElaApplication.h
        OR NOT EXISTS ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_IMPLIB}
        OR NOT EXISTS ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_RUNTIME})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ElaWidgetTools SDK is incomplete under ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_ROOT}")
endif()

add_library(ElaWidgetTools SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(ElaWidgetTools PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_IMPLIB}
    IMPORTED_LOCATION ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_RUNTIME}
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${ELA_WIDGET_TOOLS_INCLUDE_DIR}
    INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "Qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}::Widgets;D3D11;DXGI"
)
